title: FBI Digital Rendering — Western Orbs Incident
description: FBI-prepared digital recreation of the Oct 2023 federal-agent orb sightings ('grapes being expelled from a basketball'). Renderings prepared 2026; original imagery unreleased.

title: FBI Photo B2 — Infrared Still, Western US
description: Black-hot IR still of unidentified object, Dec 2025; companion Sept 2025 still shows object beneath a helicopter. Original imagery redacted before AARO submission; operator unable to identify.

title: Bronze Ellipsoid Composite
description: FBI-rendered graphic over actual site photo: ellipsoid bronze metallic object 130–195 ft, materializing from bright light, disappearing instantaneously — multi-witness corroborated.

title: Lake Huron Engagement — ATP Strike Frames
description: Frames from the first released footage of a US kinetic engagement with a UAP-designated object: AIM-9X impact, radial fragmentation, falling debris. Object likely balloon-class; recovery status undisclosed.

title: FLIR1 / GIMBAL / GoFast Stills
description: The three Navy videos officially released April 27, 2020 — the modern disclosure era's founding imagery.

title: Colares Beam Photographs
description: Military-taken photographs from the 2,000-page Prato archive: luminous objects and beam phenomena over Colares. Partially released 2010; ~95% of material still unpublished.

title: Costa Rica Aerial Mapping Frame (Lago de Cote)
description: Metallic disc captured by a government mapping aircraft's 100mm large-format camera over Lake Cote — single frame, no object in adjacent frames 20s apart. Repeatedly analyzed (GEPAN/IFO studies); widely assessed as the highest-quality official UAP photograph ever taken.
provenance: IGN Costa Rica film roll R-1978; analyses by Vallée/Haines
competing_analysis: Film-defect hypothesis examined and disfavored by grain analysis; interpretation remains open.

title: STS-48 Discovery Anomaly Frame
description: Authentic NASA footage: object near horizon executes sharp discontinuous turn and acceleration after a flash.
competing_analysis: Kasher: kinematics inconsistent with thruster-blown ice (five tests). Oberg/NASA: RCS thruster pulse on nearby ice particle. Unresolved 35 years.

title: US Navy 'Acorn' Photo
description: Object photographed from an F/A-18 over the Atlantic, March 4, 2019. DoD spokesperson Susan Gough confirmed the photos were taken by Navy personnel and included in UAPTF holdings.
provenance: Leaked April 2021; DoD authenticity confirmation on record
competing_analysis: Mylar party-balloon hypothesis proposed publicly; unresolved officially.

title: US Navy 'Metallic Blimp' Photo
description: Blimp-shaped object photographed same flight series as Acorn; part of the trio (Acorn/Blimp/Sphere) confirmed as genuine Navy-taken UAPTF imagery.

title: Calvine Photograph
description: Diamond-shaped object with jet aircraft, Calvine, Scotland, Aug 4 1990. Best of six frames handed to Daily Record then MoD; suppressed until 2022 when a print surfaced via Sheffield Hallam archive (Craig Lindsay copy). The suppression story is the placard.
provenance: Sheffield Hallam University release, Aug 2022; UK National Archives file references
competing_analysis: Hoax/reflection hypotheses argued in press; original negatives never released by MoD.

title: Lubbock Lights Formation
description: V-formations photographed multiple nights; Air Force analysis found the negatives unaltered; Project Blue Book: Unknown.
provenance: Blue Book case file; contemporary press archives

title: Phoenix Lights Frames
description: Multi-witness civilian imagery of the March 13, 1997 events; the 10pm flare drop is distinguished from the earlier mass-witnessed V-craft passage on the placard.
provenance: Multiple independent civilian recordings, local news archives
competing_analysis: USAF: A-10 flare exercise (10pm event). Earlier boomerang passage unexplained; Gov. Symington later stated he witnessed a craft.

title: McMinnville Farm Photographs
description: Two frames of a disc over an Oregon farm; endorsed as unexplained by Condon Committee photo analyst Hartmann, disputed by later suspended-model analyses.
provenance: Original negatives archived; Condon Report Case 46
competing_analysis: Hartmann: consistent with distant object. Sheaffer/IPACO: suspension-thread indications. Unresolved 75 years.

title: Petit-Réchain Triangle (Calibration Exhibit)
description: The famous Belgian Wave triangle photo — confessed styrofoam model hoax (RTL interview, 2011). Retained deliberately: the Belgian Wave's radar/F-16 data record stands entirely independent of this image. Calibration lesson: iconic imagery ≠ the case.

title: Kazakhstan 1994 — Rhodes Olympus Photos
source_org: Capt. Ed Rhodes; promised to US Embassy Dushanbe
description: Cable DOC-001 records that Rhodes photographed the object and would forward copies to the Embassy and the Tajikistan Desk (Lowry Taylor). Whereabouts unknown. ACTIVE FOIA TARGET.
provenance: 94 DUSHANBE 259, para 1 (verbatim in Parallax Document Vault)
acquisition_note: FOIA: State OES/S records 1994; Tajikistan desk files.

title: Mother-Orb Original Imagery
description: The Oct 2023 western-US incident was witnessed by multiple federal teams; PURSUE released only artist recreations. Original sensor/photographic record unpublished.
acquisition_note: Congressional request route; Luna letters already demand AARO video holdings.

title: IMMACULATE CONSTELLATION Satellite Imagery
source_org: Alleged USG program; Matthew Brown (on record May 2025)
description: Brown, former DoD analyst, states on record he authored the document entered into the Congressional Record and that the underlying repository contains imagery including a football-field-scale object. ALLEGED — single-source on content; existence of the document in the Record is confirmed, contents unverified.
provenance: Congressional Record (Shellenberger submission, Nov 2024); Weaponized Ep. 76
acquisition_note: Watch: Senate subpoena track and any IG referral.
